raw.description: 战斗开始时，自身获得1个风龙结；对手每次执行异常状态附加效果后，自身的风龙结数量+50并除以附加的概率，然后若风龙结大于500个则额外解除自身所处的异常状态|回合开始时，若自身体力高于1/2则下回合开始时反转对手的能力提升状态，反转成功则当回合受到的固定伤害、百分比伤害减少50%，未触发则对手2回合内无法主动切换精灵|战斗阶段结束时，若自身体力低于1/2则获得50个风龙结并吸取对手500点体力，若对手未受到此伤害则令对手焚烬|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]战斗开始时，自身获得1个[color=#f35555]风龙结[/color]；对手每次[color=#52a5f2]执行[/color][color=#52a5f2]异常状态附加效果[/color]后，自身的[color=#f35555]风龙结[/color]数量+50并除以附加的概率，[color=#52a5f2]然后[/color]若[color=#f35555]风龙结[/color]大于500个则额外解除自身所处的异常状态|[sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]回合开始[/color]时，若自身体力高于1/2则下[color=#57c975]回合开始[/color]时[color=#52a5f2][color=#52a5f2]反转[/color][/color]对手的能力提升状态，[color=#52a5f2]反转[/color]成功则[color=#52a5f2]当回合[/color]受到的[color=#52a5f2]固定伤害[/color]、[color=#52a5f2]百分比伤害[/color]减少50%，[color=#52a5f2]未触发[/color]则对手2回合内无法[color=#52a5f2]主动切换[/color]精灵|[sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]战斗阶段结束时[/color]，若自身体力低于1/2则获得50个[color=#f35555]风龙结[/color]并[color=#52a5f2]吸取[/color]对手500点体力，若对手未受到此伤害则令对手[color=#57c975]焚烬[/color]

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 最新三回答补全总数先加后除向上取整、零概率不计执行、增加后数量清异和反弹执行概率100%；与永沐封零资格分别遵守各自确认。

success.name: 4871真实2058战斗初1结在双方入场前，真实4822入场易燃执行后增51；4863自身与敌方沉默分别执行且不误跑回初
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058战斗初1结在双方入场前，真实4822入场易燃执行后增51；4863自身与敌方沉默分别执行且不误跑回初',()=>{for(const [id,want]of[[4822,51],[4863,101]]){const r=require('../data/species/'+id+'.json'),s=r.snapshot??r,ids=[...s.moves.filter(m=>!m.fifth).slice(-4),s.moves.find(m=>m.fifth)].map(m=>m.id),a=foreign({id,ids});assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,want);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,id===4822?1:2);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.roundStartSoulResolved,undefined);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reverseDue,undefined);for(const f of a.fighters)for(const k of f.moves)assert.equal(f.pp[k],a.moveDefinitions[k].pp);}});

success.name: 4871真实2058公共100%异常执行后才增50并按大于500清异，免疫失败仍增且不补抽，500本身不额外清
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058公共100%异常执行后才增50并按大于500清异，免疫失败仍增且不补抽，500本身不额外清',()=>{for(const [count,immune,want,cleared]of[[1,false,51,false],[450,false,500,false],[451,false,501,true],[451,true,501,true]]){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=count;if(immune)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;let seen=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const result=c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});assert.equal(result,!immune);assert.equal(c.t.soulState.wind2058.count,want);assert.equal(!!c.t.ailments['烧伤'],!immune&&!cleared);seen=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(seen,true);assert.equal(s.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,want);if(immune)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);}});

success.name: 4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','floor','overkill']){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='floor'?1:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,51);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='immune'?0:500);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],mode==='immune');if(mode==='floor'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,500);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(mode==='overkill')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);}const half=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:4500});turn(half);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].hp,4500);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1);assert.equal(sum(half,'fixed'),0);});

success.name: 4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启',()=>{const s=rawMake({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000});assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),false);s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.a.type,'龙');assert.equal(c.a.hp,9000);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.wind2058.count,0);for(const k of c.a.moves)assert.equal(c.a.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);checked=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(checked,true);assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058.length,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),500);const locked=rawMake({move:38272,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(locked),/有 PP/);assert.equal(locked.fighters[0].pp[key(38272)],1);});

success.name: 4871真实2058已为龙时满结不消费不再次满回复，风龙资源天敌红减50%与非红不减
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058已为龙时满结不消费不再次满回复，风龙资源天敌红减50%与非红不减',()=>{for(const foeType of['龙','草']){const a=make({move:20065,soul:true}),b=make({move:20065});for(const s of[a,b]){s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[1].type=foeType;}a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=1000;turn(a,20065,10127);turn(b,20065,10127);const hostile=E.typeEffectiveness(foeType,'龙',a.typeChart)>1;assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),hostile?Math.floor(sum(b,'attack',1)/2):sum(b,'attack',1));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1000);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058,undefined);}const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].type='龙';s.fighters[1].type='龙';observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['fixed','percent','true']){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,300,'独立非红伤害',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,300);}},()=>turn(s));});

success.name: 4871真实2058高体回初预约下一回初反转，届时低体仍执行且仅当回合固粉减半，成功后不延续、失败留真实换宠延期
success.assertion: test('4871真实2058高体回初预约下一回初反转，届时低体仍执行且仅当回合固粉减半，成功后不延续、失败留真实换宠延期',()=>{const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reverseDue,2);s.fighters[0].hp=4000;let reversed=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.t.stages.atk,-1);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.wind2058.reductionRound,2);reversed=true;}if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const [type,n]of[['fixed',500],['percent',500],['true',1000]]){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'预约反转减伤交互',type);assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,n);}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(reversed,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reverseDue,undefined);s.fighters[0].hp=9000;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){const hp=c.t.hp;c.hurt(c.t,1000,'下一回合独立固定', 'fixed');assert.equal(hp-c.t.hp,1000);}},()=>turn(s));const p=make({move:20065,soul:true});turn(p);timer(p,1,'强化保护');turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.reductionRound,undefined);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.deferredSwitchLocks[0].implemented,false);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.deferredSwitchLocks[0].duration,2);});

success.name: 4871已答Q001非整数向上取整且零不执行，Q002带异常跨满额后转龙归零仍清异
success.assertion: test('4871已答Q001非整数向上取整且零不执行，Q002带异常跨满额后转龙归零仍清异',()=>{for(const chance of[50,0,30]){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,2,{resolvedProbabilityPercent:chance});},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,chance?Math.ceil(51/(chance/100)):1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],chance>0);}const s=make({move:20065,soul:true});s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,'龙');assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});});

success.name: 4871真实3066受击50%成功失败都执行一次，转龙零结时两公式一致得100，监听未授前不计，RNG与无魂印对照一致
success.assertion: test('4871真实3066受击50%成功失败都执行一次，转龙零结时两公式一致得100，监听未授前不计，RNG与无魂印对照一致',()=>{const o={id:3066,ids:[16076,19415,24805,19416,19417],move:16076,native:false,converted:true,own:[10018,29265,34462,29266,38272]},seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const a=foreign({...o,seed,fast:true}),b=foreign({...o,seed,fast:true,observer:false});turn(a,10018,16076);turn(b,10018,16076);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,100);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058[0].chance,50);seen.add(!!a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);for(let i=0;i<2;i++){assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[i].pp,b.fighters[i].pp);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[i].ailments,b.fighters[i].ailments);}const early=foreign({...o,seed});turn(early,10018,16076);assert.equal(early.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,0);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);});

success.name: 4871真实3025原生389攻击20%从零得250且成功失败各一次，80%商向上取整与初始1结按总数先加后除
success.assertion: test('4871真实3025原生389攻击20%从零得250且成功失败各一次，80%商向上取整与初始1结按总数先加后除',()=>{const o={id:3025,ids:[24712,19239,24713,19240,19241],move:19239,strip:true,converted:true},seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=24;seed++){const a=foreign({...o,seed}),b=foreign({...o,seed,observer:false});turn(a,20065,19239);turn(b,20065,19239);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,250);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);seen.add(Object.keys(a.fighters[0].ailments).length>0);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);assert.deepEqual(a.fighters[0].ailments,b.fighters[0].ailments);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);for(const [move,converted]of[[24712,true],[19239,false]]){const a=foreign({...o,move,converted});turn(a,20065,move);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,converted?63:255);}});

success.name: 4871真实五星高热与火热特性8%从零得625，失败也计并清已有异常，观察不新增随机抽取
success.assertion: test('4871真实五星高热与火热特性8%从零得625，失败也计并清已有异常，观察不新增随机抽取',()=>{const o={id:3066,ids:[16076,19415,24805,19416,19417],move:16076,native:false,strip:true,converted:true,own:[10018,29265,34462,29266,38272]};for(const group of[24,45]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const a=foreign({...o,seed}),b=foreign({...o,seed,observer:false});for(const s of[a,b])s.fighters[1].build.characteristic=E.CHARACTERISTICS.normalize({groupId:group,star:5});turn(a,10018,16076);turn(b,10018,16076);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,625);assert.equal(a.windExecutionEvents2058.length,1);seen.add(!!b.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.equal(a.rng,b.rng);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);}});

success.name: 4871原执行者为对手的100%异常被自身反弹仍计一次；自身非100%异常被对手反弹按100%执行
success.assertion: test('4871原执行者为对手的100%异常被自身反弹仍计一次；自身非100%异常被对手反弹按100%执行',()=>{const a=make({move:29265,index:2,soul:true});a.fighters[0].type='龙';a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=0;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(a));assert.equal(a.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,50);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(a.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);const b=make({move:20065,soul:true});b.fighters[0].type='龙';b.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=0;timer(b,1,'reflect');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:50});},()=>turn(b));assert.equal(b.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,50);assert.ok(b.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(b.windExecutionEvents2058[0].chance,100);});

boundary.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体战阶500固定理论吸取与50结，免疫或保1零HP损失分别按完整伤害判焚烬，技能禁疗不阻魂印',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','immune','floor','overkill']){const s=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='floor'?1:mode==='overkill'?200:9000});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='floor')timer(s,1,'致命保留',{hp:1});turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,51);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),mode==='immune'?0:500);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['焚烬'],mode==='immune');if(mode==='floor'){assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,1);const e=s.damageEvents.find(e=>e.type==='fixed');assert.equal(e.settledDamage,500);assert.equal(e.hpLoss,0);}if(mode==='overkill')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);}const half=make({move:20065,soul:true,hp:4500});turn(half);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].hp,4500);assert.equal(half.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,1);assert.equal(sum(half,'fixed'),0);});

success.assertion: test('4871/12/15真实烧伤害怕随机成功失败及免疫不补抽；96烧伤才威力翻倍，404回复双方而技能禁疗只挡自身技能回血',()=>{for(const [move,status]of[[10079,'烧伤'],[10159,'害怕']]){const seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=120;seed++){const s=make({move,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});turn(s);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments[status]);}assert.equal(seen.size,2);const s=make({move,seed:0});s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments[status],undefined);}let powers=[];for(const burn of[false,true]){const s=make(row(96));if(burn)s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']=3;powers.push(powerProbe(s,()=>turn(s))); }assert.deepEqual(powers,[90,180]);for(const ban of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(404),hp:1000,targetHp:1000});if(ban)timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,ban?1000:9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000);}});

success.assertion: test('4871/781清回合成功封两回合属性而保护失败不封，449弱化才睡眠且免疫失败，463每回合500红伤额度不挡固粉真',()=>{for(const protected_ of[false,true]){const s=make(row(781));if(protected_)timer(s,1,'protect');turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,protected_?1:0);}for(const mode of['weak','normal','immune']){const s=make(row(449));if(mode!=='normal')s.fighters[1].stages.def=-1;if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠'],mode==='weak');}const s=make(row(463));turn(s);const got=[];observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)for(const type of['attack','attack','attack','fixed','percent','true'])got.push(c.hurt(c.t,300,'独立通道',type));},()=>turn(s,34462));assert.deepEqual(got,[0,100,300,300,300,300]);});

success.assertion: test('4871全部17招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与真实2058原生用招；第五由低体满结真实转龙后使用',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=rawMake({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));if(m.fifth){s.fighters[0].hp=1000;s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;turn(s,29265);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,'龙');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,0);}turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38271?m.pp:m.pp-1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4871 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.assertion: test('4871/738敌属性后仅下回合攻击封红及命中，663敌攻击才睡眠、191反弹异常，2029真实天敌令下次攻击MISS',()=>{const s=make(row(738));turn(s);for(const k of['无法造成攻击伤害','攻击技能命中效果失效'])assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects[k].end,2);turn(s,34462,10127);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);for(const move of[20117,10127]){const a=make(row(663));turn(a,29265,move);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].ailments['睡眠'],move===10127);}const r=make(row(191));observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,2,{probabilityPercent:100});},()=>turn(r));assert.equal(r.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤'],undefined);assert.ok(r.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);for(const hostile of[false,true]){const a=make({...row(2029),hit:false});a.fighters[0].type=hostile?'水':'普通';a.fighters[1].type='火';turn(a,29265,10127);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1)===0,hostile);}});

success.assertion: test('4871/893满HP全二否则全一，717按实际技能用招吸取并低体理论双回，681/843后两回合必中必暴与先制窗口',()=>{for(const hp of[9000,8999]){const s=make({...row(893),hp});turn(s);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages[k],hp===9000?2:1);}for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(717),hp:1000});if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),immune?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,7000);}for(const id of[681,843]){const s=make(row(id));turn(s);const active=Object.values(s.fighters[0].effects).filter(e=>e.start===2&&e.end===3);assert.ok(active.length>0);turn(s,34462);turn(s,34462);turn(s,34462);for(const e of Object.values(s.fighters[0].effects))assert.equal(e.start===2&&e.end===3,false);}});

success.assertion: test('4871/179同双方精灵属性威力加160、2227清强化单精灵立即执行，2274按实际恢复PP30固定理论吸取，2334暴击后两回合攻击免疫',()=>{for(const same of[false,true]){const s=make(row(179));s.fighters[1].type=same?s.fighters[0].type:'水';const power=powerProbe(s,()=>turn(s));assert.equal(power,same?400:240);}for(const protect of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2227));s.fighters[1].stages.atk=1;if(protect)timer(s,1,'强化保护');turn(s,38271,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,protect?1:0);}for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({...row(2274),hp:1000});s.fighters[0].moves.forEach(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]--);const before=Object.values(s.fighters[0].pp).reduce((n,v)=>n+v,0);if(immune)timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(s);const restored=Object.values(s.fighters[0].pp).reduce((n,v)=>n+v,0)-before+1;assert.equal(restored,6);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),immune?0:180);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1180);}const a=make(row(2334));timer(a,0,'必定暴击');turn(a);turn(a,34462,10127);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),0);turn(a,34462,10127);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),0);turn(a,34462,10127);assert.ok(sum(a,'attack',1)>0);});

success.assertion: test('4871全部17招逐实例有序编译、64种子基础与真实2058原生用招；第五由低体满结真实转龙后使用',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const c=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(c.issue,'');const s=rawMake({move:m.id,soul:true});assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]),c.operations.map(x=>[x.effectId,x.index,x.params]));if(m.fifth){s.fighters[0].hp=1000;s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;turn(s,29265);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].type,'龙');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count,0);}turn(s);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.skillUses[key(m.id)],1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38271?m.pp:m.pp-1);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...H,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('# 4871 base verified '+m.id);}assert.deepEqual(require('../local-species.cjs').issues(source),[]);});

success.assertion: test('4871真实2058低体获得50跨满额先消耗转龙、满HP与PP，已有异常不被额外清；2417实际选择资格随龙属性开启',()=>{const s=rawMake({move:20065,soul:true,hp:1000});assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),false);s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2058.count=951;s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=1;let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='combatEnd'&&c.a.side===0){assert.equal(c.a.type,'龙');assert.equal(c.a.hp,9000);assert.equal(c.a.soulState.wind2058.count,0);for(const k of c.a.moves)assert.equal(c.a.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.ok(c.a.ailments['中毒']);checked=true;}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(checked,true);assert.equal(E.availableMoves(s.fighters[0],s.round).includes(key(38272)),true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.windConversions2058.length,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),500);const locked=rawMake({move:38272,soul:true});assert.throws(()=>turn(locked),/有 PP/);assert.equal(locked.fighters[0].pp[key(38272)],1);});

interaction.assertion: test('4871/810第五每次已命中永久降威1000至0，零红仍计而控制不计；29固定1000与1156击败满HP/PP',()=>{const s=make(row(810));let powers=[];for(let r=0;r<3;r++){s.fighters[0].pp[key(38272)]=1;powers.push(powerProbe(s,()=>turn(s)));}assert.deepEqual(powers,[1000,0,0]);for(const zero of[false,true]){const a=make(row(810));if(zero)timer(a,1,'攻击伤害免疫');else a.fighters[0].ailments['害怕']=2;turn(a);assert.equal(Object.values(a.fighters[0].soulState.hits8104871??{}).reduce((n,v)=>n+v,0),zero?1:0);}const fixed=make(row(29));turn(fixed);assert.equal(sum(fixed,'fixed'),1000);const kill=make({...row(1156),hp:1000,targetHp:1});kill.fighters[0].moves.forEach(k=>kill.fighters[0].pp[k]=1);turn(kill);assert.equal(kill.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.equal(kill.fighters[0].hp,9000);for(const k of kill.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(kill.fighters[0].pp[k],kill.moveDefinitions[k].pp);});
